title: Live work, without the guessing
question: Three views of the chosen design. Content is illustrative. Task titles come from todos; agent updates are recorded messages, not generated summaries. Tool descriptions use structured names and paths. Expand the images to inspect them. “Build this” records design preference only; production code is unchanged.

options.label: Live work in the timeline
options.thesis: The active task, recorded agent update and tool events stay together in the unfinished turn.
options.viewport: Wide desktop, live turn visible; the compact dock stays hidden.
options.risk: An agent update is optional. No model call fills missing commentary or reasoning.

options.label: Read history without losing the agent
options.thesis: A compact dock appears only when the live turn leaves the viewport.
options.viewport: Wide desktop, reading earlier messages; Jump to live returns to the active turn.
options.risk: The dock must not duplicate the full summary or cover the conversation.

options.label: The same work in a narrow window
options.thesis: Keep the inbox and active task readable while the agent thinks; show only recorded text.
options.viewport: 900 × 800 desktop window; metadata wraps and the history scrolls internally.
options.risk: Active action names must remain readable rather than truncating to tool IDs.
